composition.serve_who: This sheet (108-01-520-001 rev B, "Bilge & Fire System Schematic") is the master P&ID for the vessel's combined Bilge & Fire System. It serves: the Main Bilge Pump (Gianneschi ACB431B — corrects the printed "Feit VA408" per established fact), the Electric Fire Pump (same model, separate unit), the Diesel Fire Pump ("crash pump", Aussie Pumps LF48/Yanmar L48), the Aux Bilge Pumps (Whale Gulper 320, mast + engine-room), the electrically-actuated Bilge Valves (Burkert), and the overall Bilge & Fire System card as the flow-topology holder. Evidence: title block naming the system, the pump-data table naming each pump model, BOM item tags matching established node identities, and zone labels (Lazarette/Midship/Engine Room/Mast/ESS/Sail Locker sumps) all tied into one cyan bilge main and one red fire main.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM item 003-01 'MAIN BILGE PUMP' on the flow schematic, right-of-centre pumping arrangement; established fact confirms this is Gianneschi ACB431B despite the pump-data table printing 'Feit VA408' (documentation error).

functions.label: Main bilge suction and overboard discharge
functions.what_it_does: Draws bilge water collected from all sumps via the cyan main bilge line and discharges it overboard through an anti-siphon loop.

flow_scenarios.path: Main bilge line (cyan, metallic) from all connected sumps -> seawater strainer 005-02 -> main bilge pump 003-01 suction -> pump discharge -> anti-siphon manifold (700mm above DWL) -> bilge overboard outlet
MAIN BILGE PUMP REMOTE START panel switch (per established control_loop: local switch, main panel plug C pins 6/7, or ONYX remote) closes pump contactor -> pump runs per normal path
MAIN BILGE PUMP LOCAL START switch at pump closes contactor -> pump runs per normal path

key_components: anti-siphon manifold 700mm above DWL (discharge, prevents siphon-back)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC, Gianneschi ACB431B, 300 l/min (18 m3/h), 0.75 kW, max head 17 m (table value applies to this physical pump per established identity correction); electrical_supply F7 60A fuse (established).
functions.sheet_region: lower schematic, right-of-centre (~0.85-0.93 x, 0.6-0.7 y), tag 003-01

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM item 002-02 'ELECTRIC FIRE PUMP' shown adjacent to main bilge pump in the same right-side arrangement, feeding the red fire main; matches established BOM024 identity.

functions.label: Electric fire-main pressurisation
functions.what_it_does: Draws seawater and pressurises the red fire main for hydrant/hose use fore and aft.

flow_scenarios.path: Seawater supply (fire line seawater supply tie-in) -> electric fire pump 002-02 -> discharge into fire main (red, metallic) -> sectioned at hull boundaries L,G,F,E,C,B,A -> fire hydrants/hoses in aft and fwd stowage
FIRE PUMP REMOTE START switch (aft) or ELECTRIC FIRE PUMP local switch closes pump circuit -> pump runs per normal path

key_components: fire-line seawater supply tie-in (fwd and aft)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC, Gianneschi ACB431, 230 l/min (13.8 m3/h), 1.5 kW, max head 30 m; electrical_supply F8 60A fuse (established).
functions.sheet_region: lower schematic, right side (~0.81-0.84 x, 0.61-0.66 y), tag 002-02

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM item 002-01 'DIESEL FIRE PUMP' in lazarette/tender-garage branch, lower-left of schematic, with manual pull-start note; matches register node identity (Aussie Pumps/Yanmar L48).

functions.label: Independent diesel-driven fire-main backup supply
functions.what_it_does: Provides an engine-driven backup source of pressurised seawater to the fire main, independent of ship's DC power, started manually.

flow_scenarios.path: Tender-garage seawater pickup -> seawater strainer 005-01 -> diesel fire pump 002-01 -> discharge ties into fire main (red, metallic)
Fresh-water priming line (ref DWG 108-01-510-001) crosses over to prime diesel fire pump suction before start

functions.dry_data: Yanmar L48 diesel engine driving Aussie Pumps LF48; 715 l/min (42.9 m3/h), 5.6 kW, max head 37 m.
functions.sheet_region: lower schematic, lower-left tender-garage area (~0.12-0.15 x, 0.58-0.64 y), tag 002-01

equipment_groups.equipment_name: Aux Bilge Pumps (mast + engine room, Whale Gulper 320)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM item 003-02 'E-R AUX BILGE PUMP' and item 003-01 'MAST AREA BILGE PUMP' both tagged with same Whale Gulper 320 model per established identity; two locations of the same auxiliary pump type.

functions.label: Engine-room auxiliary bilge pumping with oily-water handling
functions.what_it_does: Pumps engine-room bilge water through an oily bilge filter before overboard/portable-tank disposal, keeping oily discharge separate from the main bilge line.

flow_scenarios.path: Engine room sump pickups 006-04/006-05 -> E-R aux bilge pump 003-02 -> oily bilge filter 004-01 -> to portable oil storage tank connection 021-01/021-03, or overboard per filter output
Flex suction hose connection 021-01 manually attached -> draws from alternate bilge location -> through same aux pump/filter path

functions.dry_data: 24V DC, Whale Gulper 320, 19 l/min (1.1 m3/h), 0.1 kW, max head 3 m; electrical_supply Q2/Q3 10A breakers (established).
functions.sheet_region: lower schematic, engine-room area (~0.44-0.5 x, 0.6-0.7 y), tag 003-02

functions.label: Mast-area & ESS auxiliary bilge suction via crossover manifold
functions.what_it_does: Draws bilge water from the mast-area sump, ESS enclosure sump, and deck-locker drains through a shared suction manifold, discharging to the main bilge line/overboard.

flow_scenarios.path: Mast area sump pickup 006-06 (via valve 007-04) AND ESS enclosure pickup 006-08 (via valve 026-02) -> mast aux bilge pump suction manifold -> mast area bilge pump 003-01 -> discharge to main bilge line
FWD deck locker drain (min. 800mm above DWL) -> joins suction manifold below DWL -> pumped per normal path
Flex suction hose connection 021-01 or portable oil storage tank connection 021-03 manually attached to manifold -> pumped per normal path

key_components: mast aux bilge pump suction manifold (crossover selector)
deck locker drain (min.800mm above DWL, anti-backflow by height)
functions.dry_data: 24V DC, Whale Gulper 320, 19 l/min (1.1 m3/h), 0.1 kW, max head 3 m.
functions.sheet_region: lower schematic, mast area (~0.63-0.70 x, 0.63-0.72 y), tag 003-01 (mast)

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: BOM items 016/017 Burkert electric rotary actuators on 2-way DN050 ball valves; sheet shows motor-actuated valve symbols at aft, mast, and sail-locker area sump branches feeding the main bilge line.

functions.label: Remote electric isolation of sump branches into the main bilge line
functions.what_it_does: Allows remote/automatic opening or closing of individual sump branch lines into the common main bilge line, isolating zones as needed.

flow_scenarios.path: Sump pickup -> motor-actuated ball valve (open) -> joins main bilge line -> toward main bilge pump
Sump branch valve held NC -> no flow from that branch into main bilge line until commanded open

key_components: Burkert motor-actuated DN050 ball valves at aft/mast/sail-locker zones
functions.dry_data: Burkert electric rotary actuator (0018/BURK005) on Burkert 2-way DN050 ball valve (9670); electrical_supply Q14 10A breaker, EMERGENCY PANEL (established).

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: This is the system-level topology node per class-specific rule; holds the overall roster and cross-zone flow scenarios not owned by one single pump/valve.

functions.label: Bilge sump network feeding common main bilge line
functions.what_it_does: Collects bilge water from six distinct sump locations (Lazarette, Midship, Engine Room, Mast Area, ESS Enclosure, Sail Locker) into one metallic main bilge line for pumped overboard discharge.

flow_scenarios.path: Lazarette sump (pickup 005-01, alarm 007-01) -> valve 010-01 -> main bilge line
Midship sump (pickups 006-02/006-03, alarm 007-02) -> main bilge line
Engine room sump (pickups 006-04/006-05, alarm 007-03) -> main bilge line (separate from E-R aux oily-water path)
Sail locker sump (pickup 006-08 per this branch, alarm 007-05) -> main bilge line -> fwd stowage hose/nozzle
Per established fact: water sucked from engine room via STBD generator's raw-water pump (Jabsco 43400) through exhaust water separator, discharged overboard — alternate to main bilge pump path

key_components: bilge alarms 007-01..007-06 (level sensors, one per sump)
isolation ball valves at each sump branch (NO/NC states as labeled)

functions.label: Fire main pressurisation and hydrant distribution
functions.what_it_does: Distributes pressurised seawater along a red metallic fire main to hydrant/hose stations fore and aft, supplied by any of three pumps.

flow_scenarios.path: Fire line seawater supply (aft and fwd tie-ins) -> fire main (red, metallic) -> sectioned at L,G,F,E,C,B,A -> fire hydrants/nozzles at aft and fwd stowage
Aft hydrant -> 18m fire hose max reach (per GA dashed-line annotation)
Fwd hydrant -> 15m fire hose max reach (per GA dashed-line annotation)
